svg.title: Layered architecture (AUTOSAR-style view)
svg.desc: Each layer only uses the layers below it, through interfaces. Green tag = pure C, tested on the PC.
svg.text: Each layer only uses the layers below it, through interfaces. Green tag = pure C, tested on the PC.
state machine · sole owner of the relays
one relay per GPIO · verified by read-back
the protocol link to the PC
no application logic of its own
Rule: upper layers never call ESP-IDF directly. Hardware is reached through relay_t, pin_hal_t and link_tx_t, so
the green-tagged modules compile and run on a PC with mocks (75 unit tests), and new hardware plugs in below an interface.
